_comment: One job per STRIP — the whole strip as one image, for the concept run. Run with comic_render.py --provider runway|google|openai.

jobs.title: ROLFCOPTR · day one
jobs.prompt: a four-panel newspaper comic strip, four equal panels in a single horizontal row with thin black gutters (4 panels). Style: comic strip panel, black brush-pen ink line with muddy early-2000s digital flat colors, rubbery kinetic linework, mid-2000s webcomic look, limited palette, slightly misregistered fills. Title of the strip: ROLFCOPTR. The strip: A stick figure screams internet acronyms into an uncaring abyss. That's the strip. That's the whole strip. Panel 1: a crude stick figure with a helicopter rotor scribbled on its head standing in a blank void, crude ballpoint style, deliberately bad. Stick Hero says "LOL". Panel 2: the same crude stick figure in the same void, nothing changed. Stick Hero says "ROFL". Panel 3: the same stick figure with its rotor now spinning in three crude motion lines, void. Stick Hero says "ROLFCOPTR". Panel 4: the same stick figure hovering six inches off the ground in an indifferent void, crude, no words. on-screen text reads "". Lettering: every balloon and caption contains its complete text exactly as written, in clean hand-lettered comic capitals, large enough to read; size each balloon to fit its whole sentence and never cut a word at a balloon or panel edge; no words other than the ones given. Bottom right margin: tiny signature "A. Finch — Small Wood, OR". Reference @chorus_and_meme is a finished strip in this style. Reference @barnaby is the model sheet for BARNABY (the dog): match that face, hair and build exactly; do NOT copy its clothes, pose or props — those come from the strip text above. Reference @chloe_28 is the model sheet for CHLOE: match that face, hair and build exactly; do NOT copy its clothes, pose or props — those come from the strip text above. Match the attached references: @chorus_and_meme for the character; @barnaby for the character Barnaby; @chloe_28 for the character the strip's Chloe at 28.
